Upon the opposite wall, a series of framed artwork pieces are arranged in a variety of shapes and sizes around a keyhole archway fitted with a matching door.

36280.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Hanging upon the black walls, wooden shadow boxes are illuminated from within by thin rods of glowing blown glass.  White pine curios occupy the four corners, their tops covered in large earthen pots of glossy blue and teeming with ivy plants whose gangling limbs are coaxed into tiny hooks that encircle the room at ceiling level.  A thin runner of mingled blue and green knotwork leads to an exterior door.

36281.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Encircled by a high stone wall, the small courtyard is paved with glossy terracotta tiles and surrounded by a border of manicured grass.  At its center, a copper-lined stone fountain housing an ornate bronze statue dominates the space, while small  and chairs are secreted away amid arching arbors of mingled tea roses and peonies.  Hidden amid calico ivy leaves, a painted door provides entry to the residence.
title: [Shadowlight Gallery, Motion Art]
36282.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Cramped yet tidy, the studio has a solid mahogany floor and slate walls.  Honeycomb cubbies are built between the floor and underside of an ascending spiral staircase, the octagonal compartments filled with all manner of supplies, half-finished projects, cups, bowls, and other bric-a-brac associated with the art of creation.  A long paint-marred table provides ample room for new creations and has a tall metal-fortified stool set before it.
title: [Shadowlight Gallery, Studio]
36283.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Spartan at best, the second story fills the entirety of the residence's floor space and is built between the eves of the roof.  Tiny glass jars filled with fireflies illuminate the space and hang in profusion from the exposed rafters.  Pressed against the north and west wall, a thick blanket-laden sleeping pallet has a battered old oak footlocker at one end of it, while a mirror-topped antique wash stand rests next to a descending spiral staircase.
title: [Shadowlight Gallery, Attic]
36284.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sheltered in the heart of town and amidst a grove of trees, this earthy structure beckons visitors with an intricately carved pair of oak doors.  Hand-stripped logs of age-darkened oak are carefully placed to form the circular walls.  Two smaller outbuildings are visible around the circumference, their rounded exteriors radiating outward to match the arc of the main structure.  The triskelion architecture of the lodge is clearly discernable in the lichen-covered riverstone foundation.
title: [The Lodge, Lawn]
36285.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Plump pillows and overstuffed sofas encircle a massive riverstone fireplace sunken into the center of the room, creating a comfortable place to relax.  Large animal pelts are scattered underfoot, cutting the chill of the stone flooring.  Sturdy oaken beams bring the circular walls to a peak overhead.  Against one wall, a long sideboard offers food and drink.  A glass panel leads out to a lush garden.
title: [The Lodge, Main Lounge]
36286.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Carved into the oak panels of the far wall, a graceful tree of life spreads its branches.  Polished stone familiars are evenly spaced around the room.  Perched on rounded pedestals, they stand sentinel over small tables holding carefully placed historical artifacts. To the east of the entry, three paintings in gilded frames and an incongruous boar's head hang above the familiars.  To the west, the curved wall bears two plaques, one silver plaque and one gold plaque, hung side by side on the smooth oak paneling.
title: [The Lodge, Museum of Memories]
36287.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Finely grained teak-paneled walls join seamlessly with a polished stone block floor, blending in a flawless match of color and texture.  Dominating the center of the room is an interweaving spiral pattern etched into the floor blocks, the only decoration in an otherwise empty room.  The sole break in the seamless join of tree and earth is a square stone block embedded at hand level in the wood.
title: [The Lodge, Meditation Chamber]
36288.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Several dozen crystal shards float just below the high ceiling, illuminating the space with a multicolored display of lights.  On the floor, four interlocking circles of runic designs form a triangular pattern, echoing the triskelion construction of the building.  The main wall is scribed in silver with carefully painted characters, each of which refracts the undulating light from above.  A floating glass table hovers near a rune-carved arch.
title: [The Lodge, Enchanting Workshop]
36289.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Nestled between two radiating arcs of the lodge, the garden stretches across a pristine flora-filled lawn to the edge of a bubbling hot spring.  Swirling mists of steam rising from the water obscure a small gazebo.  Translucent lanterns sway in the breeze, casting dancing lights across the garden.  White wooden benches topped with cozy floral cushions offer comfortable seating near a silver serving cart.  A glass panel leads inside the lodge.
title: [The Lodge, Garden]
36290.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Narrow beams of moonlight stream through the wisteria vines that arch over the steam filled spring.  Tiny points of light shimmer across the surface, while heat from below maintains a steady uplift of currents.  The garden beyond is blurred by rising swirls of mist.
title: [The Lodge, Hot Springs]
36291.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The glaesineth-enclosed deck has a small door leading out and a brass-edged koa gangplank climbing up to a second-story door.  Small openings at the top of each wall let in the sea air, and their transparent nature allows an unfettered view of the dunes and ocean.  An anchor-topped coil of hempen rope sits neatly in one corner, the anchor polished to a high sheen.  Painted onto the artfully sea-weathered wood of the wall is "Welcome to the Vengeful Siren!" with a brass ship's bell hanging next to it.
title: [The Vengeful Siren, Docking]
36538.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Several small bull's-eye windows set at regular intervals line the outer walls, each outlined in gleaming brass.  The area resembles a ship's cabin, complete with an aperture leading to the west, and a silver and brass hatch with a discreet teak ladder in the ceiling.  Centered over a rattan couch is a narra-framed oil painting, and a sextant hangs next to a highly figured koa door.  Intricate marquetry in koa, teak, mahogany, and narra depicts a giant kraken in the middle of the floor.
title: [The Vengeful Siren, Main Cabin]
36539.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sunlight reflects off the gleaming brass railing lining the spacious, pointed balcony, and a sturdy koa and brass telescope occupies a break in the railing at the far point, allowing it to swivel across both island and sea.  Hanging from the wall on one side of the aperture leading inside is a carved ivory dart board.  A lacquered koa cupboard rests beneath it, a frosted glass pitcher on top pushed into the shade.  The humidity hangs heavy in the air, the tang of salt on the nigh-perpetual ocean breeze.
title: [The Vengeful Siren, Stern]
36540.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Awash in sunlight, the cozy galley is comprised of light-hued, polished wood flooring with cheerful whitewashed walls featuring ocean blue accents.  A wave-etched white stone basin sits beneath a seaglass mosaic depicting the island, and a small kitchen table is positioned near an oversized brass and koa pantry.  A narrow-tipped balcony filled with greenery is visible through a koa-inlaid glass door.
title: [The Vengeful Siren, Galley]
36541.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This room encompasses the entire third story of the building, with bull's-eye windows perfectly aligned along the length and two large picture windows on either end looking down upon the second-story balconies.  One side comprises the sleeping area, with a carved narra bed and a koa wardrobe, and the other a sitting room of sorts with a nacre-inlaid teak desk and several chairs around a riverstone fireplace.  Scattered across the polished koa and teak floor are several lamps and a few handwoven carpets, with a silver and brass hatch by one wall.
title: [Vengeful Siren, Captain's Cabin]
